processes.description: PO → receipt → bill → supplier payment/return. Receipt and bill have distinct quantity and valuation effects.
Quote/order → posted invoice → payment → credit/refund. Preserve source lineage and recognition/settlement separation.
Opening/receipt → issue → return/transfer/adjustment; quantity and valuation independently reconcile.
Reserve → dispatch → return buckets → wash/repair release; ownership, capacity and charges are distinct.
Collect liability → earned charge invoice → apply → refund remaining; no second revenue.
Parse → deduplicate → match/create → resolve outstanding → close → lock; import/match is not another money event.
Actor + current tenant + effective job/ceiling/module/domain/scope; verify every actual boundary.
Exact account/date/scope postings → subledgers → reports; distinguish current balances from historical as-of.
